summary: Searches a singly-linked list of named format entries for an entry whose entry-name matches a2 and whose secondary key (indexed through dword_8AC394 with stride 1060) matches a3; returns the matched index. When a2 equals the cleared local buffer the lookup name is replaced with the current vehicle's driver-name string (via VehicleLookupByName / CurrentVehicleAccessor). If no entry matches, allocates a fresh 176-byte entry, initializes its sub-structs and text-format block, copies a2 into it, and appends it to the list (updating head/tail/count fields); the appended index is returned. On initialization failure (sub_414600 returning non-zero) the partial entry is destroyed and -1 is returned.

Return the new entry's index (old count), i.e. v22 - 1.
